text.description_html:
First Impressions 419R-7.5-US10B Decorative Extra Long Door Stop with Rosette

Constructed of solid brass this 7.5" long very decorative wall mount door stop adds a touch of wow to any room. It is equally suited for use in private residential or high end commercial applications.

These extra long door stops are suited for special applications. Typically used to keep a door from hitting a obstacle mounted on a wall. Packaged with mounting hardware for easy installation.

Specifications of First Impressions 419 Reeded Door Stop

  • Total Length: 7.5"
  • Rosette Diameter: 1-15/16"
  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze

Note: These extra long door stops are hand crafted in the USA. They can be made to other lengths for your specific application. Please Contact Us with your requirements.

*Sold Individually
